$description: Penpot-only: Chrome's native <audio> player colors per theme, sampled from the live page on 2026-10-28, for the player drawn on Penpot's Audio post type board. The browser draws the player and no CSS reads this file; since 2026-11-17 global-styles.css keeps it dark in both themes (audio { color-scheme: dark }), so both themes carry the dark colors. Pushed into theme/light and theme/dark by build-penpot-tokens.js, names verbatim.
